popup.$description: Tokens of the popups anchored to a trigger (`PopupBase`): the chevron of the trigger, a `button`, the popup's distance and transitions. `menu` and `popover` add their panel.

trigger-gap.$description: Space between the label of the trigger and its chevron.

chevron-size.$description: Size of the chevron icon of the trigger.

popup-offset.$description: Space between the trigger and the popup.

transition-duration.$description: Entry and exit transition duration of the popup. Zero with reduced motion.

transition-timing-function.$description: Entry and exit transition easing of the popup.
